chunks: I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about a man who commits adultery while he has a concubine and a slave girl whom he has intercourse with and who is with him — does the slave girl make him muhsan? He said: Yes, because with him is what makes him needless of adultery.
I said: What if he has a slave girl but claims that he does not have intercourse with her? He said: He will not be believed.
I said: What if he has a woman in temporary marriage (mut'a), does she make him muhsan? He said: No. It is only based on what is permanently with him.

key_terms.السُّرِّيَّة: Surriyya — a concubine; a slave woman taken as a sexual partner by her owner, a legally recognized relationship in classical Islamic law
key_terms.الشَّيْء الدَّائِم: The permanent thing — the condition that the lawful sexual partner be a stable, permanent presence, not a time-limited arrangement
key_terms.الْأَمَة: Ama — a female slave; in jurisprudential context, ownership of a slave woman and regular intercourse with her was treated as analogous to marriage for ihsan purposes
key_terms.مُتْعَة: Mut'a — temporary marriage contracted for a fixed period; Shia jurisprudence recognizes this as valid but this hadith rules it insufficient for ihsan
key_terms.مُحْصَن/تُحْصِنُهُ: Muhsan — the legal status of being 'fortified' through marriage; a muhsan man who commits adultery is subject to the hadd of stoning (rajm)

ai.seo_question: Does having a slave girl or concubine make a man muhsan in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith records a jurisprudential dialogue between Ishaq ibn Ammar and Imam Musa al-Kadhim (AS) regarding the conditions for a man being classified as 'muhsan' — a married person whose adultery incurs the hadd punishment of stoning. The Imam rules that possessing a slave girl whom one regularly has intercourse with does constitute being muhsan, because she satisfies the man's lawful sexual needs; however, a mut'a (temporary) wife does not confer this status. This ruling reflects the classical Shia jurisprudential principle that ihsan (the quality of being muhsan) requires a permanent, accessible lawful partner.
word_analysis: he has sexual intercourse with her
